# The Ident

> The Ident is a UK casting app for performers and casting teams. Performers (actors, dancers, singers, musicians, presenters, voiceover artists) find castings, auditions and paid work, apply with their showreel and self-tapes, and track every self-tape, recall, pencil and booking. Casting directors, producers and companies post roles, review applicants and tapes inline, recall by self-tape, video call or in person, and book their cast.

Pricing: Performers £1.99/month, Casting £10.99/month, each after a 7-day free trial. Browsing the job board is free. No commission on work booked.

## Key pages
- [Live roles (job board)](https://theident.me/jobs): castings, auditions and paid work, updated daily
- [Talent directory](https://theident.me/people): public performer profiles with headshots, credits and skills
- [For performers](https://theident.me/performers): what performers get
- [For casting](https://theident.me/casting): what casting teams get
- [Pricing](https://theident.me/pricing): plans and FAQ
- [Contact & help](https://theident.me/contact)
- [Privacy policy](https://theident.me/privacy) · [Terms of use](https://theident.me/terms)

## Notes
- Performer profiles live at https://theident.me/<name>. Contact details are never public.
- Roles marked "Community" are posted by performers; others are posted by casting teams or shared (with credit) by The Ident.
